decided_before: any training, tuning or evaluation on application cases
unit: group_id (one application repository); every case of a group, with all its variants and both files, is in the same split
train: Lab 3 synthetic data only (data/dataset.csv, data/val_newstyle.csv); application cases are not used for training
rationale: The test set contains only real_world_app groups; the intentionally vulnerable lab (DVLA) is used for validation only.
Vanna and PandasAI have the most cases and together cover LLM02, LLM05 and LLM06.
DVLA and streamlit-agent together also cover all three categories, so model choice and thresholds can be checked on every class before the test.
The test groups must not be inspected for tuning; results on them are computed once, after the model is chosen.
